They may collaborate with finance departments to ensure adherence to budgets, reconcile invoices, and maintain financial records.\n Documentation and Filing: Managing and organizing documents, including contracts, agreements, and publishing materials. This involves ensuring proper filing systems, maintaining version control, and facilitating efficient document retrieval.\n Event Planning and Support: Assisting with the planning and execution of press‐ related events such as book launches, author signings, conferences, and promotional activities. The General Manager of the Administrative Department conducts this appraisal for administrative employees. The results of this performance appraisal are divided into four categories: A, B, C, and D. Employees who receive an A or B rating are eligible for year‐end rewards. Conversely, those who receive a C or D rating may be subject to job rotation, indicating a need for improvement in their performance or skills. The performance appraisal form is shown in Table 1.
